claim: Every odd prime p < 60 puts H_1(Sigma_p(K_n)) in the q = 1 mod p regime, where Proposition C (research/33 section 4b) proves the linking form is hyperbolic. So the branched-cyclic-cover linking-form metabolizer gate cannot fire for any D_{n,m} at any odd prime below 60.
limits: Scan, not a proof for all p. Says nothing about d-invariants, Casson-Gordon, or metabelian twisted Alexander on the same covers.
